value.rationale: The problem measures the first nonvanishing Euclidean directional-width effect of deleting all bases internal to a parallel class, a structural and natural Schubert matroid operation. The result locates a continuous Poisson shape crossover, supplies a sharp nonzero second-order mean-width deficit relative to the containing hypersimplex, and evaluates the corresponding normal-cone mass. This cannot be inferred numerically from the face-lattice/Ehrhart data and gives a reusable invariant for studying other matroid base bodies.
